notes: France's OWN mandatory B2G portal, not a commercial vendor -- there is exactly one operator for this legal channel because the French state itself is the counterparty, the same reasoning that gives 'ksef' and 'sdi' below exactly one operator each. A company can also choose 'chorus-pro' as its own free invoiceTransportId for an ordinary business client, outside B2G routing (transport-registry.ts's own header).
